title: IBM 推出芯片技术，有助于将摩尔定律再延长十年
content: IBM 在指甲盖大小的区域上构建了一种新型原型芯片，其中包含约 1000 亿个晶体管，其密度是该公司之前于 2021 年宣布的最先进技术的两倍。该设计可能为未来几年更快、更节能的计算机铺平道路。
original_title: IBM has unveiled chip technology that could help extend Moore’s Law another decade
original_content: IBM has built a new prototype chip with around 100 billion transistors on an area the size of a fingernail, which is twice the density of the company’s previous state-of-the-art technology announced in 2021. title: OpenAI IPO 延迟报道后软银股价暴跌
content: 由于担心 OpenAI 可能将首次公开募股推迟到明年并推迟其日本支持者的回报，软银集团股价下跌 12 点。
original_title: SoftBank Shares Tumble After Report of OpenAI’s IPO Delay
original_content: SoftBank Group Corp.s stock fell by 12 on concerns that OpenAI may hold off on an initial public offering until next year and delay returns for its Japanese backer.
